backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Roaf Agro Traders ICP backend, implementing user/business profiles, product catalog CRUD, order management, and role-based access control via authorization and blob-storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (agricultural animations, Tailwind keyframes, footer/page decorations) to their source files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary of short summaries for each frontend source file, describing the purpose and notable implementation details of pages, components, and config files.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS entry point that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes including colors, radius, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React SPA, setting the page title to 'Roaf Agro Traders' and mounting the app via the root div and main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application file that defines the TanStack Router route tree, Layout with Header/Footer, AdminGuard for protected routes, and wires together all page components including admin pages and profile setup modal.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Renders the site footer with an animated agro strip banner, wheat stalk SVGs, brand info, contact details, quick links, and a copyright bar.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Sticky top navigation header with logo, nav links, admin dropdown, Internet Identity login/logout, and a mobile sheet menu.
frontend/src/components/product/ProductC: Displays a single product as a card with a category image, stock/rental badges, name, description, price, and optional action buttons.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog shown to newly authenticated users prompting them to enter their name to complete profile setup, with validation and a saving state indicator.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor (anonymous or authenticated) via React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login, logout, and persisted identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports React Query hooks for all backend operations including business profile, user profile, admin check, product catalog, inventory, and sales orders.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts (Nunito, Merriweather), sets up Tailwind directives, and defines CSS custom properties for a nature-themed (earthy green/amber) light and dark color scheme.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with TanStack QueryClientProvider and a custom InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/admin/CreateOrderPage: Admin page for creating new orders by selecting products into a cart, specifying quantities and customer name, then submitting the order via a mutation hook with toast feedback.
frontend/src/pages/admin/InventoryManage: Admin inventory management page that displays inventory in a table with low-stock highlighting, and supports adding, editing, and deleting inventory items via dialogs and alert dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/admin/OrderDetailsPag: Admin page that displays full details of a single order (customer info, items, timestamps) fetched by ID, and allows updating the order status via a dropdown with toast feedback.
frontend/src/pages/admin/OrderManagement: Admin page listing all orders in a filterable table by status (pending/completed/cancelled), with inline status update controls and navigation to individual order detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ProductManageme: Admin page for managing the product catalog, supporting add, edit, and delete operations via dialogs and alert dialogs, with form fields for name, category, description, price, and availability.
frontend/src/pages/BusinessProfilePage.t: Page component that fetches and displays a business profile with decorative animated leaf/vine SVG accents, showing details like contact info, certifications, and badges using Card and Badge UI components.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page that displays a hero banner, featured available products, and product category grid by fetching business profile and product catalog data, with decorative wheat stalk and leaf SVG animations.
frontend/src/pages/ProductCatalogPage.ts: Product catalog page with search, category, and availability filters that reactively filter fetched products, featuring animated leaf divider decorations and a grid of ProductCard components.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read URL query parameters (including from hash-based routes), persist them to sessionStorage, retrieve or clear them, and strip sensitive params from the URL hash without reloading.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts (Nunito, Merriweather), an oklch-based color palette, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations; includes typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state manifest for 'Roaf Agro Traders' tracking existing features (agricultural animations on homepage, catalog, footer, and Tailwind keyframes) and a pending feature request to add stylish agro-horticultural animations.
